result.rationale: In the new parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts, computed keys like [z.string().toString()] evaluate to the literal string "[object Object]", so minimumTokenResponseSchema has one property "[object Object]" instead of validating arbitrary expiry fields; the schema therefore never validates a numeric expiry and also lacks an actual refresh_token field (line 29 then assigns it). This is verifiable from the diff and breaks the intended validation.
